basic_profile.bio: I'm a casual gamer in my late 20s, living in Austin, Texas. I recently got back into gaming after a brief hiatus and mostly play on my PS4. My interests are a mix of philosophical musings, particularly solipsism, and indulging in my favorite gaming hobbies like Monster Hunter (specifically Gunlance builds). I'm also exploring my identity and relationships, often visiting LGBTQ+ subreddits. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me a flexible schedule. I'm single, and I typically browse Reddit in the evenings when I'm winding down from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming mechanics, primarily acquired through personal experience and online forums. My knowledge in philosophy, especially solipsism, comes from self-study, reading books, and engaging in online discussions. My design skills are honed through a mix of formal education and practical experience working with clients.
